contexts.text: (The two thoughts) do not make one with the insincere and the unjust.
(Thus), with an insincere and unjust man, the internal man is formed after the image of Hell, and the external to the image of Heaven subordinate to Hell.
When anything comes up which he knows to he insincere and unjust...
They are in no charity... for they are insincere and fraudulent. Signified.
Workmen... who do their works insincerely...
